resources.string: Quickly and easily calculate your monthly loan installment!
Input must not be empty or zero.

Loan Calculator is an Android app designed to help you calculate monthly installments based on the loan amount, annual interest rate, and loan duration in months or years.


How this app works is simple: 
1. Just enter the desired loan amount. 
2. Then, enter the annual interest rate (in percent). 
3. Select the loan duration in years. 
4. Press the "Calculate" button to see the monthly installment result.


This app uses the fixed installment (annuity) method, commonly used by banks and financial institutions. The calculation formula is as follows:


Monthly Installment = [P × r] / [1 - (1 + r)^-n]


Where: 
- P is the loan amount 
- r is the monthly interest rate (annual interest ÷ 12 ÷ 100) 
- n is the number of months


With this formula, the monthly installment remains constant throughout the loan term. You can share the calculation results with others via the share feature.
